    37	static int
    38	_compare (const struct idna_table *m1, const struct idna_table *m2)
    39	{
    40	  if (m1->start < m2->start)
    41	    return -1;
    42	  if (m1->start > m2->end)
    43	    return 1;
    44	  return 0;
    45	}
    46	
    47	static int
    48	property (uint32_t cp) _GL_ATTRIBUTE_CONST;
    49	
    50	static int
    51	property (uint32_t cp)
    52	{
    53	  const struct idna_table *result;
    54	  struct idna_table key;
    55	
    56	  key.start = cp;
    57	
    58	  result = (struct idna_table *)
    59	        bsearch (&key, idna_table, idna_table_size,
    60	                 sizeof (struct idna_table),
    61	                 (int (*)(const void *, const void *)) _compare);
    62	
    63	  return result ? result->state : UNASSIGNED;
    64	}
    65	
    66	int
    67	_idn2_disallowed_p (uint32_t cp)
    68	{
    69	  return property (cp) == DISALLOWED;
    70	}

    72	int
    73	_idn2_contextj_p (uint32_t cp)
    74	{
